title: CSV, JSON, Avro, Parquet and ORC
scope: A comprehensive data-file-formats course covering text and binary serialization, CSV/TSV, JSON/JSON Lines, XML, Avro, Protocol Buffers, Thrift, Parquet, ORC, Apache Arrow/IPC/Feather, schemas, logical types, nested data, compression and encoding, partitioning, splittability, object-storage behavior, schema evolution, interoperability, corruption detection, security, benchmarking, migration, and production data-lake design.
coverage_note: Current open data-format specifications and ecosystem practice, including Parquet row groups/pages/indexes, ORC stripes/indexes, Avro schema resolution, Apache Arrow 25.x columnar/IPC concepts, compression, object-store layout, and lakehouse interoperability
